snippet.title: Ghatika | Dev.  Diary 1
snippet.description:
Step into a world that captures the historical and cultural tapestry of South Asia. Embark on a journey through lush landscapes and vibrant areas to help build a settlement for the refugees under your command. 

Slated for an initial release on PC, Ghatika is a single player 2D side scrolling game currently in early production. The features are being designed to encourage strategic thinking and resource management, providing players with a sense of accomplishment as they watch their settlement grow and thrive. A deep narrative system with unique characters and world events will tie all these systems together.

This video provides a visual representation of the core mechanics, art style, and narrative elements that players can expect from Ghatika. With many more features in the pipeline, this play through  offers a glimpse into the unique and engaging experience that awaits.

For more information, visit:
www.glassjarinteractive.com
